meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定制Claude的记忆模式,让重要内容按场景自动记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望Claude按场景记住关键信息并提醒你
copy.tagline_en: Create custom memory modes so Claude tracks what matters by scenario
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Claude to remember key details per scenario and remind you

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先问你在做什么，提出一套笔记分类（观察类型 + 概念标签）请你确认，再安装并激活自定义 claude-mem 模式；可选配 Telegram 提醒，并重启 worker 验证生效。
howto.when: 当你要求定制 claude-mem 记住什么、创建或修改模式、添加观察类型或标签等，或为特定记忆设置 Telegram 通知时触发，即使你没说“mode”一词。

say.text: 帮我建一个记录设计决策和客户偏好的 claude-mem 模式
say.note: Claude 先访谈，再提出分类方案等你确认

say.text: 每次记录生产事故时，用 Telegram 通知我
say.note: 会先问是否已有 bot，再走安全配置

say.text: 看看现有模式里有没有能直接改用的
say.note: 它会先检查已有和捆绑的模式

howto.what_en: Claude interviews you about your work, proposes a small note taxonomy (observation types plus concept tags), and after your approval installs and activates a custom claude-mem mode; optional Telegram alerts, plus worker restart and verification.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram alerts for certain memories—even without saying "mode".

say_en.text: Create a claude-mem mode that records design decisions and client preferences
say_en.note: Claude interviews first, then proposes a taxonomy

say_en.text: Telegram-alert me whenever a production incident is recorded
say_en.note: Checks for an existing bot, then secure setup

say_en.text: Check existing modes for one I can adapt
say_en.note: It inspects bundled and user modes first
